# Laboratory Tests

This folder contains specific laboratory test codes used within the Danish healthcare system to track clinical quality indicators for patients with atrial fibrillation. The pages detail various national and regional identifiers for measuring thyrotropin (TSH) and creatinine, which are essential for fulfilling diagnostic and safety monitoring requirements under the "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (AFDK) program. By standardizing these codes, the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) ensures accurate registry tracking of initial thyroid workups and annual kidney function assessments for patients on direct oral anticoagulants.

## Pages

- [[ass00039-p-thyrotropin|ASS00039]] — Laboratory code for TSH measurement used to satisfy clinical quality indicator 3 for atrial fibrillation diagnostics.
- [[ass00136-p-thyrotropin|ASS00136]] — Systemic reference code for thyrotropin tracking diagnostic quality under indicator 3 in the AFDK program.
- [[ass00647-p-thyrotropin|ASS00647]] — Administrative and clinical code registering TSH measurements to fulfill indicator 3 requirements for atrial fibrillation workups.
- [[dnk35895-p-thyrotropin|DNK35895]] — Approved laboratory code verifying that an atrial fibrillation patient has undergone required TSH testing for indicator 3.
- [[np03578-p-thyrotropin|NPU 03578]] — Diagnostic code qualifying as a completed TSH measurement under national clinical quality guidelines for atrial fibrillation.
- [[np03624-p-thyrotropin|NPU03624]] — Standardized code used by RKKP to track TSH measurements in national health registries for atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[np04199-p-thyrotropin|NPU04199]] — Valid laboratory code satisfying the TSH measurement requirement for indicator 3 in the Danish atrial fibrillation quality initiative.
- [[np04200-p-thyrotropin|NPU04200]] — Designated code that qualifies as a completed TSH measurement for tracking diagnostic testing in atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[np27547-p-thyrotropin|NPU27547]] — Laboratory code critical for tracking indicator 3 compliance by registering TSH measurements in the AFDK database.
- [[npu03577-p-thyrotropin|NPU03577 (P-Thyrotropin)]] — Specific code used to monitor diagnostic follow-up, tracking TSH measurements within a strict timeframe around the initial atrial fibrillation diagnosis.
- [[npu04998-p-kreatinin|NPU04998 (P-Kreatinin)]] — Code measuring serum creatinine to monitor kidney function annually in atrial fibrillation patients treated with DOACs, predominantly used in Region Hovedstaden and Region Sjælland.
- [[npu18016-p-kreatinin|NPU18016 (P-Kreatinin)]] — Alternative laboratory code for annual serum creatinine monitoring in DOAC-treated patients, primarily utilized in Region Syddanmark and Region Nordjylland.
- [[p-creatinin|P-creatinin]] — Plasma creatinine parameter serving as the core measurement for indicator 4b to ensure safe DOAC administration through annual renal assessments.
- [[s-creatinin|S-creatinin]] — Serum creatinine parameter used as the core metric for indicator 4b, mandating annual kidney function monitoring for prevalent atrial fibrillation patients on DOACs.
